signIn.subtitle: Sign in to check in
signIn.invalidInput: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number and your password.
signIn.employeeForgot: Forgot your password? Ask your admin.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of Mukham ({{current}}) is no longer supported. Please install version {{required}} or newer.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.title: Your face data
consent.p1: We save one photo of your face to confirm it is you at sign-in and check-in.
consent.p2: It is stored privately and never shown to anyone.
consent.p3: It is deleted when you leave the organisation.

face.title: Look at the camera
face.hint: Hold the phone at eye level, in good light.
face.failed: The face check didn't pass. Please try again.
face.expired: Sign-in took too long. Please enter your password again.
face.permissionBody: Mukham needs the camera for the live face check.
face.unavailableTitle: Face check needs the Mukham app build
face.unavailableBody: The live face check uses native code that Expo Go and the browser don't include. Install the Mukham development build on this phone to sign in as an employee. Admins can sign in here.

register.title: Register your organisation
register.name: Organisation name
register.invalidInput: Enter the organisation name and a valid 10-digit mobile number.
register.doneBody: Sign in as Admin with mobile number {{mobile}} and this password. Write it down now; it is shown only once.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.body: Enter your organisation's email. We'll send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this email, a reset link is on its way. Open it on any device to set a new password, then sign in here.

admin.dashboardPlaceholder: Today's totals, charts and the department leaderboard arrive in Phase 5.
admin.attendancePlaceholder: Every employee's attendance and manual check-in arrive in Phase 5.
admin.peoplePlaceholder: Employees, the org chart and tasks arrive in Phase 6.
admin.setupPlaceholder: Departments, designations, shifts, office locations and the organisation profile arrive in Phase 7.

checkIn.outsideBody: You are {{distance}} from {{office}}. Move closer and try again.
checkIn.faceFailedBody: Hold the phone at eye level, in good light, and try again.
checkIn.permissionBody: Mukham needs your location to confirm you're at the office.
checkIn.permissionBlocked: Location access is turned off for Mukham. Turn it on in Settings, then try again.
checkIn.servicesOff: Location is turned off on this phone. Turn it on and try again.
checkIn.timeout: Couldn't get a GPS fix. Move near a window or outside, then try again.
